input_boundary: active_memories are supplied directly; retrieval is not evaluated
description: Unseen holdout cases for final planner evaluation. These cases must not be used for prompt tuning.

metric_definitions.false_delete_rate: Among cases where no DELETE is expected, the fraction where the planner emits DELETE.
metric_definitions.false_update_rate: Among cases where no UPDATE is expected, the fraction where the planner emits UPDATE.
metric_definitions.unsafe_mutation_rate: Across all cases, the fraction containing an UPDATE or DELETE whose operation and target index do not match an expected mutation.
metric_definitions.duplicate_create_rate: Among cases tagged duplicate, the fraction where the planner emits CREATE for information already represented by an active memory.

cases.description: A negated goal must not delete an unrelated behavioral pattern.
cases.user_message: Learning to play piano is no longer one of my goals.

active_memories.content: The user tends to avoid asking for feedback after making mistakes.

cases.description: One goal is abandoned while a different goal is created.
cases.user_message: I no longer want to run a triathlon. I have decided to learn Spanish this year.

active_memories.content: The user wants to complete a triathlon.

cases.description: Independent clauses require deletion and update of different memories.
cases.user_message: I have dropped my plan to write a novel. I now prefer studying in the morning instead of at night.

active_memories.content: The user wants to write a novel.
The user prefers studying at night.

cases.description: Only the matching goal may be updated when multiple goals exist.
cases.user_message: For my photography goal, I want to focus specifically on portrait photography.

active_memories.content: The user wants to improve at photography.
The user wants to learn conversational Italian.

cases.description: Each mutation contains only the fact represented by its target memory.
cases.user_message: I now prefer remote work, and I have decided to start saving for a house.

active_memories.content: The user prefers working from an office.

cases.description: A request for assistance is not evidence of a durable goal.
cases.user_message: Can you help me prepare for tomorrow's presentation?

cases.description: Tentative language does not establish a durable commitment.
cases.user_message: Maybe one day I could try learning the guitar.

cases.description: One isolated event does not establish a behavioral pattern.
cases.user_message: I felt nervous during my meeting this morning.

cases.description: Only the abandoned goal may be deleted when two goals are active.
cases.user_message: The marathon is off my list, but I am still committed to finishing my degree.

active_memories.content: The user wants to finish a university degree.
The user wants to run a marathon.

cases.description: A missing abandoned goal is not deleted, while a new durable preference is created.
cases.user_message: I have given up on opening a bakery. I prefer receiving feedback face to face.

active_memories.content: The user wants to publish a collection of short stories.

cases.description: Two durable facts in one message require separate atomic creates.
cases.user_message: Creativity is central to how I choose work, and I have decided to move to Lisbon next spring.

cases.description: Repeated behavior stated explicitly is sufficient for a recurring pattern.
cases.user_message: Whenever a deadline gets close, I repeatedly avoid checking my progress until the last minute.

cases.description: A paraphrase of an existing preference must not create a duplicate memory.
cases.user_message: I prefer scheduling focused work during the morning.

active_memories.content: The user prefers doing focused work in the morning.
